purpose: Retrieval and integrity record for the Q1 2026 ST12000NM0008 cohort-construction feasibility run (cohort construction and feasibility validation)

retrieval.method: direct download (curl -fL to Git-ignored data/raw/data_Q1_2026.zip; not extracted)

builder_run.command: PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/build_cohort_skeleton.py --zip-path data/raw/data_Q1_2026.zip --expect-manifest results/audit/data_manifest.json --output-dir data/processed/q1_cohort
builder_run.stdout_note: stdout (accounting incl. event counts by baseline group) redirected to the ignored data/processed/ tree and not inspected; see docs/q1_cohort_feasibility.md
builder_run.determinism_rerun: independent second run to a scratch directory produced byte-identical cohort_drives.csv and cohort_accounting.csv

environment.remotezip: not installed (not needed for Option A)

retention: ZIP and serial-level outputs stay in Git-ignored data/raw and data/processed; never committed
